rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a frightening dream and, by extension, a very unpleasant or difficult experience.

example.english: I had a nightmare last night and couldn't get back to sleep all night.
example.traditional: 我噚晚發咗個惡夢，成晚都瞓唔返。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 maan5 faat3 zo2 go3 ok3 mung6 seng4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 faan2
